video_title: Clippers vs. Pelicans | Postgame Interviews | Nov. 8, 2026 | LA Clippers

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the energy and versatility of Bones Hyland
quotes.excerpt: his ability to make plays off the dribble of getting to the basket, getting to the paint
quotes.quote: I think his energy, his ability to make plays off the dribble of getting to the basket, getting to the paint, and then defensively just being able to switch some, be in a drop, blitz, and he is all-purpose, be able to do a little bit of everything. With Brook having some fouls and Isaiah being out, he played a lot of minutes and just learned the lessons for him throughout the course of the season, but I thought he did a good job.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Bones Hyland: He is all-purpose, be able to do a little bit of everything. With guys out, he played a lot of minutes and just learned the lessons for him throughout the course of the season.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue discusses the versatility and performance of Bones Hyland during a postgame interview.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the team's focus on reducing turnovers
quotes.excerpt: that's been hurting us, the difference in a few wins by just turning the basketball over
quotes.quote: I think understanding that that's been hurting us, the difference in a few wins by just turning the basketball over. Just keep talking to the guys, keep showing them. I thought Darius did a great job of just making the simple pass, then getting it back, then attacking so the defense wouldn't be set and locked in on him. We just played team basketball the whole game for 48 minutes and having 34 assists tonight, just sharing the basketball, attacking and making the right play.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on the team's focus on reducing turnovers: Understanding that that has been hurting us. We just played team basketball the whole game for 48 minutes and having 34 assists tonight.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue explains the team's focus on ball security and praises Darius Garland for his decision-making.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on maintaining composure during opponent runs
quotes.excerpt: just keep our composure and challenge the guys in the timeout, just to stay with it
quotes.quote: Just keeping our composure and challenge the guys in the timeout, just to stay with it. They are going to make a run, it's a game of runs. They were way bigger than us in every position, so just stay with it, continue to the process, playing the same way, playing through the game. I thought our guys did a good job of just trusting that and playing for 48 minutes.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on maintaining composure: Just keeping our composure and challenge the guys in the timeout, just to stay with it. They are going to make a run, it is a game of runs.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue reflects on the team maintaining composure during the opponent's scoring runs.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland's composed performance
quotes.excerpt: was tonight probably like the most composed and even-keeled you've seen him through four quarters?
quotes.quote: I think so. And I think just trusting, I think trusting, making the simple pass, you know, getting it back, attacking, more movement when we when teams switch, we have more movement, more actions to try to keep them off balance and I thought he did a great job of attacking and then knowing when to make the right pass and right play. Having 10 assists was huge for us too.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland: I think just trusting, making the simple pass, you know, getting it back, attacking. Having 10 assists was huge for us too.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue analyzes Darius Garland's performance and his ability to facilitate the offense.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the impact of Kobe Brown off the bench
quotes.excerpt: he's a lottery pick, so we knew he was talented
quotes.quote: I mean he's a lottery pick, so we knew he was talented. And sometimes it's about the right fit, sometimes it's about opportunity, sometimes it's about rotation. You never know. He's definitely come in and played really well. I think playing confident, playing free, he gives us speed, athleticism, you know, just being able to steal the ball, get out in transition, you know, a few dunks, attacking the basket, a great cutter, and he's making his three-point shot as well. So just just staying confident.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Kobe Brown: He is definitely come in and played really well. I think playing confident, playing free, he gives us speed, athleticism, you know, just being able to steal the ball, get out in transition.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue discusses the impact and development of Kobe Brown off the bench.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on overcoming the mental hurdle of fourth-quarter collapses
quotes.excerpt: got our composure back and got tougher, instead of going the other way thinking oh here we go again
quotes.quote: It was good for us. It was good for us to see and like Darius said, they came back, took the lead, we we got our composure back and got tougher, instead of going the other way thinking oh here we go again. I thought our guys really refocused in that timeout, came out and had the right intent and we got our our mojo back.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on overcoming fourth quarter collapses: It was good for us to see and like Darius said, they came back, took the lead, we got our composure back and got tougher, instead of going the other way thinking oh here we go again.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue discusses the team's mental resilience in the fourth quarter following a timeout.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the professionalism of Brook Lopez
quotes.excerpt: every day he's in here working, no matter if it's an off day or not
quotes.quote: Just, you know, him being a professional. Every day he's in here working, no matter if it's an off day or not, blackout day or not, he's in here working every single day. No matter if we ask him to come off the bench, if we ask him to start, you know, whatever it may be, he's always ready to play and I think being positive to the young guys, showing those guys how to be professional, he's been great for us.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Brook Lopez: No matter if we ask him to come off the bench, if we ask him to start, you know, whatever it may be, he is always ready to play and I think being positive to the young guys.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue praises the professional attitude and work ethic of Brook Lopez.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the team's commitment to sharing the basketball
quotes.excerpt: our whole model and theme all year has been making a play for your teammate
quotes.quote: Just taking care of the basketball was huge for us, only having 11 turnovers. And like I said, a couple of them down the stretch, you know, when the game was out of hand. But just taking care of the basketball, making the simple plays, and our whole model and theme all year has been making a play for your teammate and I thought they did a good job with that tonight.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on sharing the ball: Just taking care of the basketball was huge for us, only having 11 turnovers. Our whole model and theme all year has been making a play for your teammate.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue emphasizes the team's commitment to sharing the basketball and limiting turnovers.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the floor game of Bones Hyland
quotes.excerpt: he was going to blitz, they were going to be up on the pick and rolls
quotes.quote: I thought he did a good job. We talked about how they were going to play us yesterday, you know, he was going to blitz, they were going to be up on the pick and rolls and I thought he did a good job of handling those blitzes and making the right pass and right play. And then off the ball, just, you know, making his open threes and catch and shoot shots. So, he's been good. Just, you know, it's going to be some ups and downs, he's 19 years old, but we have a lot of confidence in him, he has a lot of confidence in himself.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Bones Hyland: He is 19 years old, but we have a lot of confidence in him, he has a lot of confidence in himself.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on the team's unselfish play and transition offense
quotes.excerpt: I think it's just the unselfish basketball that we play
quotes.quote: I think it's just the unselfish basketball that we play. As a bench unit, you want to be able to continue what the starting unit does and just bring a lot of energy and don't let it be a fall from the starters to the bench. We wanted to go out there and take pride on both ends of the floor, want to get stops and I think we played really good in transition and got a lot of deflections and steals and we rebounded well to get the ball out in transition. I think that's what helped us a lot.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown: I think it is just the unselfish basketball that we play. As a bench unit, you want to be able to continue what the starting unit does and just bring a lot of energy.

structured.context: Kobe Brown explains the importance of unselfish play and energy from the bench unit.
